english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for richly detailed or intricately complex decoration and design.
Use this for something made up of many detailed or interlocking parts, especially when it feels elaborate or cumbersome.

examples.english: The carvings on this old castle are baroque but beautiful.
examples.traditional: 呢座古堡嘅外牆雕花繁複得嚟好靚。
